The word 'Nikon' is legibly printed on the camera's pentaprism hump
A partial model designation appears to start with 'D8' but the remaining digits are obscured/too small to read clearly in this image
A lens is attached with a front cap on; a gold/bronze decorative ring is visible near the lens mount, consistent with some Nikon pro-grade lenses but no lens brand or focal-length text is legible
A semi-transparent 'STARSHOOT IMAGE' watermark overlays the center of the photo, obscuring some body detail
No LCD screen, battery compartment, memory card slot, strap, box, or included accessories are visible
No back-of-camera shot, no power-on or image-preview shot, no serial number or shutter-count readout shown

claims.claim: Nikon D810 DSLR Camera + 24-70mm Lens for Sale
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'Nikon' branding but the full model number and lens markings are not legible
No close-up of sensor, LCD, body wear, or functional test is shown
No accessories, box, battery, charger, or strap are visible in the single photo

risks.risk: Actual body model may not be a D810 (could be a cheaper or different Nikon DSLR)
risks.proof: Clear, unobstructed close-up of the top-plate model badge and the camera's rear LCD screen with model info visible
risks.if_unproven: priced as unspecified/base Nikon DSLR body, not as D810

risks.risk: Lens may not be a genuine Nikon 24-70mm (could be third-party or different focal length)
risks.proof: Photo of lens barrel showing brand name, focal length, and aperture markings with cap removed
risks.if_unproven: priced as unbranded/unknown lens, not as Nikon 24-70mm

risks.risk: Shutter count and sensor condition unknown; could have high mileage or sensor dust/scratches
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or EXIF data, plus a photo of a test shot showing clean sensor

risks.risk: Functional status (autofocus, image stabilization, buttons, dials) unverified
risks.proof: Short video clip showing camera powering on, autofocus engaging, and a live-view or test shot

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card, box) despite 'comes with...' claim being cut off
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Watermark suggests image may be reused from another listing/stock source rather than the seller's actual unit
risks.proof: A fresh, unwatermarked photo from multiple angles taken by the seller today, ideally with a handwritten note or timestamp

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the top-plate model badge (full 'D810' text) in good lighting
Clear photo of the lens barrel with brand, focal length, and aperture markings visible (cap off)
Photo or screenshot of the shutter count from the camera menu
Short video of the camera powering on, autofocusing, and taking a sample shot
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card, box) laid out together
A few unwatermarked photos from different angles taken fresh by the seller
response.reason: The seller claims a specific high-value model (Nikon D810) and lens (24-70mm), but the single photo only confirms the 'Nikon' brand, not the model or lens identity, and no functional or accessory evidence is shown, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without clearer identifying and condition proof.
